name: Disfear
description:
'''Disfear''' is a Swedish [[crust punk]] band that formed in the early 1990s and recorded sporadically over the years. After releasing the albums ''[[Soul Scars]]'' in 1995 and ''[[Everyday Slaughter]]'' in 1997, the group did not release another album until 2003 with a 12-track album, ''[[Misanthropic Generation]]'', featuring vocalist [[Tomas Lindberg]] of [[At the Gates]] and [[The Great Deceiver (band)|The Great Deceiver]]. They later worked with [[Converge (band)|Converge's]] [[Kurt Ballou]] for their album ''[[Live the Storm]]'' featuring Uffe Cederlund of [[Entombed (band)|Entombed]].

Bassist Henke Frykman died of cancer on 25 March 2011, Vocalist Tomas Lindberg died of cancer on 16 September 2025. Marcus Andersson died from brain cancer in September 2026, at the age of 52.
